title: shape index
description: Written by the builder to <world>/kantobridge/shape_index.json (docs/specs/VOXEL_BLOCKS_PLAN.md §4.2): the world's shape keys. Pixel-free names of shapes (which rule, which tile ids and offsets); each client builds their geometry from its own art. Canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact); shapeIndexHash is its SHA-256, so the planner version and parameters are inside the hash. Keys come from the whole export, never from a build's map filter. A geom id is an index into geoms; a shape id is an index into instances plus 1 (0: no shape).

planner.description: The planner and its version, e.g. kb-shapes/1.

atlases.description: Sorted atlas image ids; keys refer to them by index.

palettes.description: Sorted palette ids; instances refer to them by index.

geoms.description: Sorted canonical shape keys (cube, slab, roof, tuft, cell, tmpl); geom id = index.

templates.description: From V7: one entry per structure template (a bounded building a door folds into), sorted by sig. What a client needs to rebuild it from its own art: the tile grid (w x d art tiles, -1 outside the structure; one cell row more for its doors), the door cells, the ground tile, the outdoor flag, and per grid position its Tier A keys bottom-up (its fallback, which fixes its volume). sig is the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the canonical entry without sig; a tmpl key names one block of it. From P2 (docs/specs/PROFILE_PLAN.md §5.5) an entry may carry band, a band-table building: its columns are then empty, and band.solid gives each position's volume (its fallback: the plain cube of its own tile).

band.description: From P2: the profile's band-table building this template draws, pixel-free numbers only: the band table (roofRows, roofBack, roofFront, roofCycle, slab, frontEave, ledge, seal, depthPx, panes, scrub), the composite grid (top: rows drawn above the matched rows; rows: the matched grid), the overhang rows (north, south), and per grid position the solid blocks of a claimed solid tile (solid) and the decor blocks of its doorway or overhang (air); claimOnly for a claim that draws nothing.

instances.description: Sorted [geomId, paletteIndex] pairs; shape id = index + 1.
